command:
python3 -c 'import json,re,subprocess,hashlib,yaml
from pathlib import Path
base=Path("openspec/changes/publish-private-connectivity-production-contract")
origin=yaml.safe_load((base/".openspec.yaml").read_text())["origin"]
permission=json.loads((base/"review/source-owner-permission.json").read_text())
assert origin["approved_by"]=="Brett Heap in session; see review/ratification.md" and origin["approved_on"]
assert "Status: ratified" in (base/"proposal.md").read_text()
assert "Ratified:" in (base/"review/ratification.md").read_text()
assert permission["decision"]=="accepted" and permission["owner"]=="Brett Heap"
assert permission["mode"]=="source" and permission["scope"]["phase"]=="source"
assert all(permission["boundaries"][name] is False for name in ("allocates_version","advances_pins","authorizes_tag","authorizes_target_effects"))
surfaces=[]
for row in (base/"design.md").read_text().splitlines():
 if row.startswith("| "):
  path=row.split("|")[1].strip()
  if path.startswith(("contracts/","scripts/","tests/","specs/")):surfaces.append(path)
assert permission["accepted_publication_surfaces"]==surfaces and len(surfaces)==11
assert permission["proposal_sha256"]==hashlib.sha256((base/"proposal.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
raw=Path("contracts/manifest.yaml").read_bytes()
prior=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD^:contracts/manifest.yaml"])
assert raw==prior
version=yaml.safe_load(raw)["contract_bundle_version"]
changed=subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only","HEAD^","HEAD","--","contracts/"]).decode().splitlines()
assert changed==[] and not Path("contracts/private-connectivity/binding.schema.json").exists()
assert re.search(r"^target_release:\s*deferred-allocation",(base/"proposal.md").read_text(),re.M)
subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/validate-openspec-cli-pin.py","--change","publish-private-connectivity-production-contract","--strict"],check=True)
facts={
 "neutral-owner-acceptance":{"owner":permission["owner"],"roles":permission["roles"],"actual_decision_at":permission["actual_owner_input"]["at"],"raw_record_sha256":permission["actual_owner_input"]["raw_record_sha256"],"origin_approved":True,"ratified":True},
 "publication-reader-scope":{"accepted_surfaces":surfaces,"proposal_sha256":permission["proposal_sha256"],"source_only":True,"release_policy":permission["custody_process"]["release_policy"]},
 "late-version-allocation":{"existing_bundle_version_unchanged":version,"contract_tree_diff":changed,"supported_schema_not_yet_published":True,"target_release":"deferred-allocation","version_or_inventory_allocated_by_this_check":False,"tag_operation_requested_by_this_check":False}
}
print("N_ACCEPTANCE_FACTS="+json.dumps(facts,sort_keys=True))
'
